translations.web: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
translations.bsb: Like one who removes a garment on a cold day or vinegar poured on a wound is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
translations.kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
translations.asv: As one that taketh off a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon soda, So is he that singeth songs to a heavy heart.
